title: Kinetic Overcharge Sigil Strike: Active placement mechanic where timing an inscription input with the lattice's inward breathing pulse supercharges the sigil, emitting a directional shockwave that displaces adjacent ambient energy embers and fractures neighboring partition borders.
author_role: Lead Gameplay & Kinematics Specialist (State machines, physics integration, collision rules)
summary: Introduces a cadence-timed Kinetic Overcharge inscription window synced to lattice inhalation that detonates an impulse wave fracturing adjacent partitions.
technical_specification: Lattice breathes via `state.world.breathWindow = Math.sin(state.world.singularity.pulsePhase)`. When player fires inscription (`state.keys.Space || state.pointer.justDown`), evaluate resonance window: if `breathWindow >= 0.82`, trigger Overcharge. Set `state.world.sectors[i].overcharged = true` and `state.world.shake = 8.5`. Spawn 24 kinetic shockwave fragments radiating at `v = (cos(theta), sin(theta)) * 320`. Iterate adjacent sector borders; increment their `fractureLevel` by 1 (max 3), altering divider stiffness and pushing neighboring floating embers back by `Math.max(0, 110 - dist) * 1.8` px.
acceptance_criteria: Inscribing during peak pulse crest triggers instant screen kick and radial particle blast across adjacent sectors.
Partition borders adjacent to the overcharged sector gain structural cracks without blocking subsequent valid moves.
